manifest.title: Release Manifest
manifest.heading: Release Manifest
manifest.subtitle: Source builds are active today. Public installers, signing and verification artifacts are in preparation.
manifest.headline: RELEASE_01 lists three platforms and publishes no artifact.
manifest.footnote: The manifest carries a release index, a channel and a per-platform status. It carries no version, no release date and no artifact size - those print UNAVAILABLE until a public installer publishes them.
manifest.empty: No release is published. The manifest prints the fields it cannot fill as UNAVAILABLE; the source build is the only path that exists.

transparency.title: Telemetry Is Compile-Gated.
transparency.subtitle: Telemetry and tracing sit behind named Rust feature gates in the native layer. Nothing is emitted by default; each build profile explicitly lists which paths are compiled in.
